usage: agentware kb-git push [-h] [--path PATH]
                             [--on-prose-conflict {abort,pause}]
                             [--max-retries MAX_RETRIES]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --path PATH           KB repo dir to push (default: the resolved knowledge
                        dir)
  --on-prose-conflict {abort,pause}
                        same-entry (non-derived) conflict disposition: 'abort'
                        fails loud (default); 'pause' leaves the rebase in
                        progress + lists the conflicted entry files (rc 3) for
                        the MERGE_PROMPT
  --max-retries MAX_RETRIES
                        bounded pull→resolve→push retries on a re-push race
                        before failing loud (default: 3)
